name: SongRec Button
description:
A quick settings button that runs SongRec to recognize the song your computer is playing.

Nothing is recorded until you press the button. Then it records a few seconds of your computer's sound (or the input you choose) with PipeWire's pw-record and runs the songrec command you installed, which sends a fingerprint of that sound to Shazam's servers and returns the song. A notification says what was found, and the button's menu keeps a history, in the extension's settings. Clicking a song opens its Shazam page, opens a search for it, or, if you choose, copies its title and artist to the clipboard.

Not affiliated with SongRec, Shazam or Apple. SongRec is an unofficial Shazam client.
